functions.name: blz_max_packed_size
functions.description: Returns an upper bound on the compressed size for an input of src_size bytes. Use this to size the destination buffer before calling blz_pack or blz_pack_level.
requirements: src_size is the number of bytes to be compressed (must fit in size_t).
Caller uses the returned value to allocate a destination buffer large enough for worst-case output.

functions.name: blz_workmem_size
functions.description: Returns the required size, in bytes, of the temporary workmem buffer for compressing src_size bytes at the default compression level.
requirements: src_size is the number of bytes to be compressed (must fit in size_t).
Caller must allocate a workmem buffer of at least the returned size when using blz_pack for the same src_size.

functions.name: blz_pack
functions.signature: unsigned long blz_pack(const void *src, void *dst, unsigned long src_size, void *workmem);
functions.description: Compresses src_size bytes from src into dst and returns the number of compressed bytes produced. Requires a temporary workmem buffer sized appropriately via blz_workmem_size for the given src_size.
requirements: src must point to at least src_size readable bytes.
dst must point to a writable buffer of at least blz_max_packed_size(src_size) bytes to hold worst-case compressed output.
workmem must point to a writable buffer of at least blz_workmem_size((size_t)src_size) bytes.
src_size is the number of bytes to compress (unsigned long).
Caller should use the return value as the exact number of bytes written to dst.

functions.name: blz_workmem_size_level
functions.description: Returns the required size, in bytes, of the temporary workmem buffer for compressing src_size bytes at a specified compression level. Levels 1–9 trade time/space for ratio; level 10 is optimal but very slow.
requirements: src_size is the number of bytes to be compressed (must fit in size_t).
level selects compression level; documented levels are 1–10.
Caller must allocate a workmem buffer of at least the returned size when using blz_pack_level with the same src_size and level.

functions.name: blz_pack_level
functions.signature: unsigned long blz_pack_level(const void *src, void *dst, unsigned long src_size, void *workmem, int level);
functions.description: Compresses src_size bytes from src into dst using the specified compression level and returns the number of compressed bytes produced. Levels 1–9 provide increasing compression and cost; level 10 is optimal but very slow. Requires a workmem buffer sized via blz_workmem_size_level.
requirements: src must point to at least src_size readable bytes.
dst must point to a writable buffer of at least blz_max_packed_size(src_size) bytes to hold worst-case compressed output.
workmem must point to a writable buffer of at least blz_workmem_size_level((size_t)src_size, level) bytes.
level selects compression level; documented levels are 1–10.
Caller should use the return value as the exact number of bytes written to dst.

functions.name: blz_depack
functions.signature: unsigned long blz_depack(const void *src, void *dst, unsigned long depacked_size);
functions.description: Decompresses data from src into dst, producing exactly depacked_size bytes. Returns the number of decompressed bytes (expected to equal depacked_size).
requirements: src must point to a valid compressed stream that expands to exactly depacked_size bytes.
dst must point to a writable buffer of at least depacked_size bytes.
depacked_size is the expected size of the decompressed data (unsigned long).
Caller should treat the return value as the number of bytes written and expect it to equal depacked_size.

functions.name: blz_depack_srcsize
functions.signature: unsigned long blz_depack_srcsize(const void *src, void *dst, unsigned long src_size);
functions.description: Decompresses data from src into dst when only the compressed size src_size is known. Returns the number of decompressed bytes. This function is unsafe: if the data is malformed, it may read beyond src_size from src.
requirements: src must point to at least src_size readable bytes of compressed data; malformed data may cause reads beyond this bound (unsafe).
dst must point to a writable buffer large enough to hold the full decompressed output; the function has no explicit output-size limit parameter.
src_size is the number of bytes available in src.
Caller should only use this on trusted/well-formed inputs and must rely on external knowledge to provision dst capacity.

functions.name: blz_depack_safe
functions.signature: unsigned long blz_depack_safe(const void *src, unsigned long src_size, void *dst, unsigned long depacked_size);
functions.description: Safely decompresses from src to dst, reading at most src_size bytes and writing at most depacked_size bytes. Returns the decompressed size on success or BLZ_ERROR on error.
requirements: src must point to at least src_size readable bytes.
dst must point to a writable buffer of at least depacked_size bytes.
src_size is the size of the compressed data bound; the function will not read beyond it.
depacked_size is the maximum allowed decompressed size; the function will not write beyond it.
Caller must check the return value for BLZ_ERROR ((unsigned long)(-1)) and handle errors accordingly.

data_types.description: An unrestricted byte buffer of any length, containing arbitrary 8-bit values. Not assumed to be text or in any particular format; may include null bytes and any binary content.

A byte stream formatted according to the BLZ compressor’s output format, suitable for input to blz_depack or blz_depack_srcsize. It is produced by blz_pack or blz_pack_level from arbitrary binary input and contains all necessary framing/metadata for decompression.
